title: support-bot Helm values
description: JSON Schema for support-bot chart values. Enforced by Helm 3 BEFORE any template rendering, so a bad install fails fast at the client with a clear error. Resolves M7 ('bad Helm values fail at install time, not silently at runtime') from WP05 v1 review Issue 1 -- the previous pre-install-hook implementation was structurally unable to validate the Secret and ConfigMap because pre-install hooks run before any release resources exist.

secret.description: API keys + tokens mounted as a Kubernetes Secret. All values default to empty strings -- the operator MUST supply them at install time via --set or an external secret manager (NFR-003 / SecretScrubber).

openaiApiKey.description: OpenAI API key for the answerer adapter (WP02). Must be non-empty and look like a real OpenAI key (sk-<base62>, >=20 chars after the prefix) so that operators catch typos at install time rather than at first request.

embeddingApiKey.description: OpenAI API key for the OpenAI embedder backend. Optional -- only required when EMBEDDER_BACKEND=openai. If supplied, must follow the same sk-<base62> shape as openaiApiKey so operators catch typos. Use null (the default) when EMBEDDER_BACKEND=local.

chromaAuthToken.description: Chroma auth token. Optional -- only required when CHROMA_AUTH_TOKEN is set in the Chroma server config. Use null (the default) for unauthenticated Chroma.

config.description: Application configuration mounted as a Kubernetes ConfigMap (WP04 / composition/settings.py).

logLevel.description: Application log level (DEBUG/INFO/WARNING/ERROR). Defaults to INFO in values.yaml.

sourceUrl.description: URL the ingestion pipeline scrapes on first start (FR-001 / PageScraper port). Must be a non-empty absolute HTTP(S) URL -- the ingestion cannot scrape an empty or relative URL.

answererBackend.description: Answerer implementation selector. 'openai' = ChatOpenAI (default), 'fake' = deterministic for tests.

analyzerBackend.description: WP06 page analyzer selector. 'openai' = OpenAIPageAnalyzer (LLM-driven, default), 'none' = skip the analyze step (FixedSizeChunker fallback).

chunkerBackend.description: WP06 chunker selector. 'hybrid' = HybridChunker (consumes PageStructure; default), 'fixed_size' = FixedSizeChunker (WP03 fallback).

openaiPageAnalyzerModel.description: WP06 OpenAI chat-completions model used by the page analyzer (e.g. 'gpt-4o-mini').

lowConfidenceThreshold.description: Cosine similarity floor below which LowConfidencePolicy refuses to answer. Pydantic v2 parses this as a string -> Decimal.
